internalMilestones.M8: Repository housekeeping, not something the tool does for its users.

features.title: Says whether the page can ship
features.caption: It says whether the page is ready to ship, and how many fixes stand in the way.
features.alt: The report's headline: the release verdict and the number of fixes needed first.

features.title: Checks what people rely on
features.caption: It checks keyboard use, screen-reader use, page structure and colour contrast, and marks what needs fixing.
features.alt: Four report rows, keyboard access, virtual reader, semantics and visual contrast, each with its result.

features.title: Hears what a screen reader hears
features.caption: It lists what a screen reader announces with no name, where a blind user cannot tell what a control does.
features.alt: The report's virtual reader row, listing each item announced without a name.

features.title: Explains who each problem affects
features.caption: Each problem says, in plain words, who it affects.
features.alt: A fix in the report: its title and a sentence on who the problem affects.

features.title: Proposes a fix you can check
features.caption: It proposes a fix you can check: a colour that passes, next to the one that fails.
features.alt: The current text colour next to a proposed colour, each with its contrast ratio.

features.title: Points to every affected spot
features.caption: It marks each affected spot on a picture of the page.
features.alt: A crop of the tested page with the affected text outlined and labelled.

features.title: Uses the page with a keyboard alone
features.caption: Using only the keyboard, it tabs to every control, then presses each one to check it does what a click does.

features.title: Reads the page like a screen reader
features.caption: What a blind user hears: a screen reader reads the page from top to bottom.
